Play one game at a time.” 🏀🔥 That’s the March Madness mindset from Tennessee State Head Coach Nolan Smith Jr., the Prince George’s County (DMV) legend leading the TSU Tigers after winning the Ohio Valley Conference regular-season championship — their first since 1995. Coach Smith discusses how Tennessee State is staying focused heading into the OVC Tournament and building momentum for a potential March Madness run.
